Gordon with the starting line, but is up in smoke and she is off the throttle.  Then Pruett is up in smoke and
Gordon tries to get back on, but couldn't get it to hook up.  Pruett pedals it and gets it to hook up enough
for the win.  She will give up lane choice to Torrence in the semifinal.
